1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan Tambahan Bagi Tahun 2019) 2020.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan tambahan bagi tahun 2019

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi sembilan belas juta tujuh ratus

dua puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM19,724,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan tambahan untuk pentadbiran Sistem Insurans

Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2019 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Harta tanah, loji dan kelengkapan 19,724,000

Jumlah 19,724,000

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM

(ADDITIONAL SUPPLY FOR THE YEAR 2019) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1)

of the Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System

(Additional Supply For The Year 2019) Regulations 2020.

Issue for additional expenditure for the year 2019

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding nineteen million seven hundred and

twenty four thousand ringgit (RM19,724,000) from the Employment Insurance System

Fund for the additional expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance

System for the year 2019 is hereby authorized for the purpose specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Landed properties, plants and equipment 19,724,000

Total 19,724,000

Made 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/28/3; PN(PU2)747/II]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
